Name: Timsanity's Floral Megamix Redux
Author: Timmeep
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][size=5]Welcome to my the Content Patcher Remake of Timsanity's Floral Megamix for Stardew 1.6![/size][/b][/font]

[font=Georgia][size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[size=4]A whopping [/size][b][size=5]112 Crops[/size][/b][size=4] (most of them with multi-yields)[/size]
[size=3]11 Fruit Trees, and 5 of them are only available from the Island Trader
Farm Type Manager Support[/size]
[size=3]5 New Gems, Sapphire, Full-Moon Jewel, Glistening Raindrop, and Ancient Crystal, and Crystalline Perennial.

[font=Georgia][size=5][b]Major Changes[/b][/size][/font]
I removed a good amount of crops that I feel like they didn't add much to the mod, as well as as crops & items that directly overlap (with a few exceptions) with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20340]Growable Forage and Crop Bushes, [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25619]Vanilla Forage Crops and Bushes[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]More Flowers[/url].
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11778]Market Day[/url] content removed, as that mod hasn't updated for 1.6 yet.
Certain crops are now sold at festivals (refer to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2568]article[/url]).
Mushroom crops are now sold by the Dwarf.
Dogwood, Ruby Blood Orange, Spooky Ghost Apple, and Snow Fir saplings are now sold by Krobus.
The recipes for all of my scarecrows are now learned when you reach level 1 farming.

[font=Georgia][b][size=5]Credits:[/size][/b][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=3]Mizu for the rose starter trellis and seeds[/size][size=3] (Mizu said it was ok to use [/size][size=3]the sprites, as long as you give credit.) [/size][url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/mizus-sprites.136549/]https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/mizus-sprites.136549/[/url][/font][/size][/font]
